articles.title: Renan Santos, candidato do Missão à Presidência, cumpre agenda no RJ | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato disse que vai cortar gastos públicos para permitir que os juros caiam a uma taxa entre oito e nove pontos percentuais.
articles.summary: Candidato disse que vai cortar gastos públicos para permitir que os juros caiam a uma taxa entre oito e nove pontos percentuais.
articles.body:
O candidato do Missão , Renan Santos , cumpriu agenda no estado do Rio.

Renan Santos chegou a Niterói no começo da tarde e foi recebido por apoiadores na Praça Arariboia, Centro da cidade. Ele subiu em um carro de som e discursou. Depois, em entrevista, o candidato do Missão falou sobre economia. Disse que vai cortar gastos públicos para permitir que os juros caiam a uma taxa entre oito e nove pontos percentuais. Segundo Renan, dessa forma, será possível estimular a economia e gerar emprego:

“Para o jovem ter emprego e renda, você tem que ser capaz de criar empregos. E, para ser capaz de criar empregos, você precisa criar empresas. E, para criar empresas, você precisa ter juros baixos. Juros baixos e segurança jurídica são o caminho para que os jovens brasileiros possam ou criar a própria empresa, ou criar a própria startup, como os jovens do mundo inteiro estão fazendo, ou ir trabalhar em uma nova empresa, ou em uma empresa já estabelecida. Para você fazer isso, você precisa cortar despesas como se não houvesse amanhã. Nós vamos cortar mais de R$ 250 bilhões de despesas do governo federal”.

Renan Santos também falou sobre segurança pública. Disse que, se for eleito, vai investir em ações para acabar com o crime organizado.

articles.title: Eleições 2026: veja como foi o dia dos candidatos ao Governo do Maranhão nesta terça (1º) | G1
articles.standfirst: Veja como foram as atividades de campanha de André Luís, Dimas Cassimiro, Eduardo Braide, Felipe Camarão, Orleans Brandão, Reginaldo Lima, Roberto Rocha e Saulo Arcangeli.
articles.summary: Veja como foram as atividades de campanha de André Luís, Dimas Cassimiro, Eduardo Braide, Felipe Camarão, Orleans Brandão, Reginaldo Lima, Roberto Rocha e Saulo Arcangeli.
articles.body:
Os candidatos ao Governo do Maranhão cumpriram compromissos de campanha nesta quinta-feira (1º), em diferentes municípios do estado. As agendas incluíram carreata, panfletagem, encontros com eleitores e reuniões políticas.

Eduardo Braide (PSD), Felipe Camarão (PT) e Saulo Arcangeli (PSTU) apresentaram propostas relacionadas à alimentação e à segurança alimentar. André Luis (Missão), Orleans Brandão (MDB) e Reginaldo Lima (PCB) também cumpriram agendas de campanha. Roberto Rocha (PRTB) não teve compromissos eleitorais, enquanto Dimas Casimiro (PCO) não divulgou a agenda.

O primeiro turno das eleições será realizado no dia 4 de outubro. Já o segundo turno, caso necessário, está marcado para 25 de outubro

Acompanhe abaixo como foi a agenda dos candidatos ao Governo do Maranhão, em ordem alfabética.

André Luis (Missão) teve, pela manhã, agenda na feira do Maiobão, em Paço do Lumiar.

Dimas Casimiro (PCO) não divulgou a agenda de campanha.

Eduardo Braide (PSD) cumpriu agenda no interior do Maranhão. Em Rosário, o candidato participou de uma carreata em cima de um caminhão e parou em frente à rodoviária, onde conversou com eleitores e recebeu apoio de moradores.

Durante a agenda, Braide apresentou propostas para ampliar o acesso à alimentação e garantir a segurança alimentar no estado.

“O Maranhão tem 50% dos seus habitantes abaixo da linha da pobreza. Por isso, um dos problemas que a gente tem que enfrentar é a insegurança alimentar. Garantir o direito básico da alimentação a cada maranhense''.

Felipe Camarão (PT) iniciou a agenda pública na região do Médio Mearim. Ele chegou a Lago Verde por volta das 16h, onde foi recebido por moradores da cidade e da zona rural em uma fazenda próxima à entrada do município.

Em seguida, participou de uma carreata. Durante a agenda, o candidato apresentou propostas relacionadas aos restaurantes populares, à agricultura familiar e à compra de alimentos para a merenda escolar.

“Evidentemente, nós vamos continuar com o programa dos restaurantes populares, que foi ampliado, incrementado pelo ex-governador Flávio Dino. Indo na minha gestão, nós vamos concluir e colocar, inclusive, mais de um restaurante por cidade, especialmente nas maiores cidades do Maranhão. O que o presidente Lula mandar de compra da agricultura familiar, nós vamos dobrar no nosso plano de governo.”

Depois de Lago Verde, Felipe Camarão seguiu para Caxias, onde encerrou os compromissos de campanha no interior do estado com uma carreata.

Orleans Brandão (MDB) participou, pela manhã, de uma carreata em São José de Ribamar. À tarde, teve um encontro com quilombolas e participou de uma carreata em Paço do Lumiar. À noite, tem reunião política em São Luís.

Reginaldo Lima (PCB) fez panfletagem pela manhã, em Imperatriz. À tarde, participou de um almoço com apoiadores. À noite, tem reunião com a coordenação de campanha.

Roberto Rocha (PRTB) não teve agenda de campanha nesta quinta-feira (1º).

Saulo Arcangeli (PSTU) fez panfletagem nesta quinta-feira (1º), durante a manhã, acompanhado da equipe de campanha, em frente à Universidade Federal do Maranhão (UFMA), na área do Itaqui-Bacanga, em São Luís. Durante a atividade, apresentou o plano de governo aos eleitores.

Em entrevista, o candidato falou sobre propostas para combater a insegurança alimentar. Ele defendeu investimentos na agricultura para garantir o fornecimento de alimentos para serviços públicos e afirmou que pretende criar medidas para controlar a expansão de terras e do agronegócio.

“Vamos garantir compras públicas para a agricultura familiar, para abastecer as escolas, os hospitais, as cozinhas e os restaurantes populares, porque alimentação é um direito. Não podemos deixar essas pessoas passando fome, enquanto no Maranhão os grandes empreendimentos só lucram.”

articles.title: Karina Zeviani, ex-The Voice Brasil, morre aos 51 anos em SP | G1
articles.standfirst: Artista estava em tratamento contra um câncer. Homenagens serão realizadas em Jaboticabal, no interior de São Paulo.
articles.summary: A cantora Karina Zeviani, ex-participante do The Voice Brasil, faleceu após lutar contra um câncer e receberá homenagens em Jaboticabal, no interior de SP.
articles.body:
A cantora e compositora Karina Stefania Zeviani — Foto: Reprodução/ Redes sociais

Morreu nesta quinta-feira (1º) aos 51 anos a cantora e compositora Karina Stefania Zeviani. A ex-participante do "The Voice Brasil" estava em tratamento contra o câncer em São José do Rio Preto (SP).

Natural de Jaboticabal (SP), a artista deixa os pais e o marido. Segundo informações da funerária Prever, as homenagens à cantora serão nesta sexta-feira (2).

O velório será realizado no Complexo Funerário Terra Nossa, com início às 11h e encerramento às 17h, em Jaboticabal. O enterro está marcado para as 17h, no Cemitério Municipal.

A morte de Karina mobilizou pessoas próximas, como a atriz Luana Piovani e a modelo Luciana Curtis, que lamentaram nas redes sociais.

"Hoje minha amiga amada descansou, mas vai deixar muita saudade. Estou com o coração partido", publicou a modelo.

Karina vinha enfrentando uma batalha contra o câncer, com complicações de saúde registradas ao longo do ano. Em janeiro, a doença apresentou progressão para o fígado, desencadeando quadros graves de infecção, anemia com necessidade de transfusões de sangue e internação em UTI.

Amigos e familiares chegaram a organizar uma mobilização solidária para auxiliar nos custos de medicamentos e acompanhamento médico.

Nas redes sociais, Karina compartilhava com os seguidores atualizações sobre seu estado de saúde.

Em um de seus relatos mais recentes, a cantora contou que havia obtido mais de 90% de remissão após as primeiras sessões de quimioterapia no início do ano. No entanto, exames posteriores apontaram novos pontos nos ossos e no fígado. Após tentar um protocolo com quimioterapia oral por um mês sem a resposta esperada, ela explicou que passaria a fazer quimioterapia intravenosa.

No vídeo, demonstrou abatimento ao saber que perderia o cabelo novamente, mas reafirmou sua fé e confiança na recuperação, pedindo orações e apoio dos fãs.

A cantora e compositora Karina Stefania Zeviani morreu aos 51 anos. — Foto: Reprodução/ Redes sociais

Com carreira internacional, Karina Zeviani iniciou na música em 2005, integrando o coletivo norte-americano "Thievery Corporation".

Em 2008, tornou-se uma das vocalistas do projeto francês "Nouvelle Vague". Após nove anos vivendo entre Londres, Paris e Nova York, retornou ao Brasil e lançou, em 2012, seu primeiro álbum solo autoral, "Amor Inventado".

Em 2020, Karina ganhou projeção nacional ao participar da nona temporada do programa "The Voice Brasil", na Globo. Na fase de audições às cegas, a cantora, então com 45 anos, emocionou os jurados ao interpretar "Sonhos", clássico de Peninha.

Sua apresentação arrancou elogios de Lulu Santos e um convite de Carlinhos Brown, que a escolheu para integrar seu time ao declarar "Você é brilhante!"

articles.title: Araceli Lemos propõe exigir verticalização da produção mineral no Pará | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidata do PSOL ao Governo do Estado cumpriu agenda de campanha com caminhada na Terra Firme, em Belém, nesta quinta-feira, 1º.
articles.summary: Candidata do PSOL ao Governo do Estado cumpriu agenda de campanha com caminhada na Terra Firme, em Belém, nesta quinta-feira, 1º.
articles.body:
A candidata do PSOL ao Governo do Pará, Araceli Lemos , disse nesta quinta-feira (1º) que quer exigir a verticalização da produção mineral no estado, condicionando o licenciamento ambiental ao beneficiamento local das riquezas extraídas e à contratação de mão de obra paraense.

"Ninguém vai explorar nossas riquezas sem ter a contrapartida para gerar e deixar os recursos aqui no Estado. Sobretudo com a nossa mão de obra", afirmou.

Araceli participou de uma caminhada na feira do bairro da Terra Firme, em Belém . O ato de campanha mobilizou apoiadores no início do dia e contou com a presença da candidata a vice-governadora, Fátima Santana.

Durante a agenda, a candidata conversou com moradores e feirantes, distribuiu material de campanha e discursou em frente à feira sobre a posição do Pará no ranking de Índice de Desenvolvimento Humano (IDH). Ela também apresentou propostas voltadas para o desenvolvimento sustentável e a valorização do trabalhador.

A candidata do PSOL prometeu investimentos nas cadeias de produtos naturais da biodiversidade local, como o açaí, o cacau e óleos essenciais, por meio de incentivos fiscais e linhas de crédito voltadas para pequenos produtores e para a agricultura familiar.

"Então, para nós, ter um olhar para essa riqueza nossa é de fundamental importância. Garantir que essa riqueza seja nossa e não dos outros, não patenteada pelos outros, é obrigação de quem governa com seriedade o Estado", explicou.

Araceli também defendeu a redução de intermediários na comercialização desses produtos, visando aumentar o valor recebido pelo produtor na saída e diminuir o preço final pago pelo consumidor.

Além disso, Araceli detalhou propostas para o mercado de trabalho, como a criação do "salário pai d’égua" no valor de R$ 2.200 para os trabalhadores seletistas do estado, e a implementação da jornada na escala 5x2 para todos os terceirizados contratados pelo governo estadual.

"Com relação ao que vai impactar no orçamento, é importante dizer que o salário de R$ 2.200,00 é para os seletistas do Estado. Não é necessariamente uma política só para os servidores públicos, é para quem tem carteira assinada. E para ele funcionar, tem que ser enviado para a Assembleia um projeto de lei que eu mandarei no início do meu governo, como uma das primeiras ações," declarou.

A candidata propôs ainda realizar uma auditoria em todos os grandes contratos de serviços e nas isenções fiscais concedidas pelo estado, com o objetivo de cobrar débitos acumulados de empresas que não cumprem com as contrapartidas e combater desvios.

articles.summary: O prêmio para o ganhador da edição desta quinta-feira é de R$ 72,2 milhões.
articles.body:
O sorteio do concurso 3.065 da Mega-Sena foi realizado na noite desta quinta-feira (1º), em São Paulo. O prêmio para as apostas que acertassem as seis dezenas era de R$ 72,2 milhões . No entanto, ninguém levou a faixa principal e o valor acumulou em R$ 82 milhões .

Veja os números sorteados: 08 - 10 - 30 - 38 - 50 - 53

5 acertos: 47 apostas ganhadoras, R$ 49.503,22

4 acertos: 3.642 apostas ganhadoras, R$ 1.053,03

O g1 passou a transmitir, desde abril, todos os sorteios das Loterias Caixa, ao vivo . A transmissão começa momentos antes de cada dia de concursos, no site e no canal do g1 no YouTube .

Resultado do concurso 3065 da Mega-Sena. — Foto: Reprodução/Caixa

A aposta mínima custa R$ 6 e pode ser realizada também pela internet, até as 20h – saiba como fazer a sua aposta online .

Os jogos podem ser realizados até as 20h (horário de Brasília) em qualquer lotérica do país ou por meio do site e aplicativo Loterias Caixa, disponíveis em smartphones, computadores e outros dispositivos.

Já os bolões digitais poderão ser comprados até as 20h30, exclusivamente pelo portal Loterias Online e pelo aplicativo.

O pagamento da aposta online pode ser realizado via PIX, cartão de crédito ou pelo internet banking, para correntistas da Caixa. É preciso ter 18 anos ou mais para participar.

A Mega tem três sorteios semanais: às terças, quintas e domingos .

A probabilidade de vencer em cada concurso varia de acordo com o número de dezenas jogadas e o tipo de aposta realizada. Para um jogo simples, com apenas seis dezenas, que custa R$ 6, a probabilidade de ganhar o prêmio milionário é de 1 em 50.063.860, segundo a Caixa.

Já para uma aposta com 20 dezenas (limite máximo), com o preço de R$ 232.560,00, a probabilidade de acertar o prêmio é de 1 em 1.292, ainda de acordo com a instituição.

articles.title: Planos de saúde são obrigados a fazer mamografias em mulheres com menos de 40 anos que tenham indicação médica | G1
articles.standfirst: Antes, os planos tinham obrigação de cobrir o exame só para pacientes entre 40 e 69 anos.
articles.summary: Antes, os planos tinham obrigação de cobrir o exame só para pacientes entre 40 e 69 anos.
articles.body:
Planos de saúde são obrigados a fazer mamografias em mulheres com menos de 40 anos que tenham indicação médica — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

A partir desta quinta-feira (1º), os planos de saúde são obrigados a fazer mamografias em mulheres com menos de 40 anos que tenham indicação médica.

A fisioterapeuta Raquel Castanharo teve câncer de mama em 2025. A poucas semanas, quando tentou marcar uma mamografia de acompanhamento, o pedido foi negado pelo plano de saúde.

“Eu tirei uma mama, mas eu tenho uma mama ainda em mim que precisa ser monitorada com muito cuidado. Quando eu recebi a negativa de fazer a mamografia, uma negativa automática porque eu não tenho 40 anos, eu e minha médica, a gente não entendeu, porque é óbvio que eu preciso fazer uma mamografia. Eu sou uma paciente de alto risco. E isso está documentado no plano de saúde”, diz Raquel Castanharo.

A partir de quinta-feira (1º), os planos de saúde não podem mais negar a cobertura de mamografia digital para mulheres com menos de 40 anos que tenham indicação médica para a realização do exame. A mudança foi aprovada pela Agência Nacional de Saúde. Antes, os planos tinham obrigação de cobrir o exame somente para pacientes entre 40 e 69 anos.

“Os planos de saúde sempre foram a favor dessa decisão. A mamografia digital dá muito mais precisão ao diagnóstico e fazer o diagnóstico precoce para câncer de mama, assim como outros problemas oncológicos, é fundamental para uma saúde da mulher mais bem gerenciada, maiores chances de cura a custos muito mais em conta”, afirma Bruno Sobral de Carvalho, diretor-executivo da Federação Nacional de Saúde Suplementar.

Os mamógrafos digitais, que produzem imagens mais precisas e detalhadas, já são a grande maioria dos equipamentos usados na rede particular e no SUS . A mamografia não é indicada para todas as mulheres abaixo dos 40 anos. Mas é um exame fundamental para mulheres que, mesmo mais jovens, fazem parte de um grupo considerado de alto risco para câncer de mama.

“Seja por história familiar ou até uma história pessoal de câncer de mama ou ovário, essas mulheres, sim, têm indicação. Mas isso não é uma regra. Exames de menos são ruins, mas exames demais também podem ter problemas, tais como alarmes falsos”, diz Guilherme Novita, presidente da Sociedade Brasileira de Mastologia.

A Sociedade Brasileira de Mastologia orienta que, a partir dos 40 anos, as mulheres façam mamografia anualmente. Uma lei, aprovada no fim de 2025, também garante que pacientes nessa faixa etária realizem o exame no Sistema Único de Saúde.

“A gente tem uma quantidade no Brasil de diagnóstico tardio muito alta, seja na população de planos de saúde e pior ainda na população de saúde pública. A detecção precoce é a melhor arma que a gente tem contra o câncer de mama”, afirma Guilherme Novita.

articles.summary: Candidato do PSB participou, nesta quinta-feira (1º), de debate promovido pelo Sistema Jornal do Commercio de Comunicação, no bairro de Santo Amaro, no Centro do Recife.
articles.body:
O candidato ao governo de Pernambuco, João Campos ( PSB ), afirmou que pretende fortalecer o setor cultural do estado com a criação do "Pernambucoflix", uma plataforma gratuita de streaming voltada para a produção audiovisual pernambucana, além de ampliar ações de incentivo às manifestações artísticas (veja vídeo acima) .

O postulante participou, nesta quinta-feira (1º), do debate promovido pelo Sistema Jornal do Commercio de Comunicação, no bairro de Santo Amaro, no Centro do Recife . Durante o programa, ele discutiu propostas para áreas como saúde, educação e cultura.

"Nós faremos várias ações. Eu vou destacar duas: vamos lançar o 'Pernambucoflix', [que] é um streaming de Pernambuco para a gente ter o audiovisual de Pernambuco à disposição de forma gratuita para os pernambucanos. Além disso, vamos lançar os Jogos Escolares da Cultura, onde nas escolas terão apresentações artísticas e as competições serão feitas no grande ciclo estadual de Cultura", disse em entrevista à TV Globo .

João Campos chegou acompanhado de assessores. O debate foi dividido em quatro blocos, com perguntas de temas livres e também assuntos definidos por sorteio. No último bloco, dedicado às considerações finais, apresentou compromissos voltados ao fortalecimento da cultura em Pernambuco.

Após o debate, João Campos fez uma carreata em Jaboatão dos Guararapes e uma caminhada no Cabo de Santo Agostinho , no Grande Recife

articles.title: Lito Sousa, influenciador e especialista em aviação, morre em São Paulo | G1
articles.standfirst: Ele revelou, em agosto, ter descoberto ter Creutzfeldt-Jakob', uma doença neurológica rara, degenerativa e ainda sem cura, causada por proteínas anormais.
articles.summary: Ele revelou, em agosto, ter descoberto ter Creutzfeldt-Jakob', uma doença neurológica rara, degenerativa e ainda sem cura, causada por proteínas anormais.
articles.body:
Lito Sousa, influenciador e especialista em aviação que sofria com doença rara, morre em São Paulo — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

Morreu nesta quinta-feira (1º), em São Paulo, o especialista em aviação e influenciador digital Lito Sousa.

Depois de ter trabalhado por mais de três décadas em grandes companhias aéreas, Joselito Geraldo de Sousa criou um canal na internet para explicar, de forma simples, assuntos complexos da aviação. E assim, Lito Sousa, como ficou conhecido, ajudou muita gente a superar o medo de voar. Com 10 milhões de seguidores, se tornou um dos maiores influenciadores nas redes sociais.

Lito Sousa nasceu em Natal e tinha 59 anos. Era piloto e mecânico de aeronaves, especializado em segurança de voo. Diagnosticado com câncer de próstata, Lito Sousa revelou, em agosto, ter descoberto um outro problema de saúde: “Creutzfeldt-Jakob”. Uma doença neurológica rara, degenerativa e ainda sem cura, causada por proteínas anormais. A doença compromete os movimentos e provoca perda de memória.

“Começou a acontecer uma coisa muito estranha com o meu braço esquerdo. Eu comecei a perder um pouco de movimento, um pouco de controle, e eu percebi isso quando eu estava digitando um roteiro. A minha mão não agia do jeito que eu queria”, contou Lito Sousa.

A notícia provocou comoção entre os seguidores. A esposa de Lito, Mila, postou um vídeo pedindo ajuda:

“Se alguém souber de alguma coisa, algum tratamento”.

Nas últimas semanas, Lito se submeteu a um tratamento experimental com um remédio importado dos Estados Unidos, ainda em fase de testes. Ele morreu em um hospital em São Paulo. O influenciador deixa esposa e filho. Mila usou as redes sociais para fazer uma homenagem ao marido:

“Me falaram que as pessoas boas, que cumprem sua missão com excelência, vão para perto de Deus mais rápido”.

Em um de seus últimos vídeos, Lito deu mais uma lição: como se despedir:

“Queria dizer a vocês que não precisa ficar triste. Eu tive a vida mais maravilhosa que alguém pode ter”.

articles.title: “Não deixe o verde dar lugar às cinzas”: FRAM lança campanha contra queimadas na Amazônia | G1
articles.standfirst: Fundação Rede Amazônica alerta para os riscos das queimadas urbanas e rurais e orienta sobre cuidados para evitar a propagação do fogo.
articles.summary: Fundação Rede Amazônica alerta para os riscos das queimadas urbanas e rurais e orienta sobre cuidados para evitar a propagação do fogo.
articles.body:
Campanha da Fundação Rede Amazônica busca a conscientização ambiental contra queimadas. — Foto: Fundação Rede Amazônica.

A Fundação Rede Amazônica (FRAM) lançou a campanha institucional Consciência Limpa Queimadas, que chama a atenção para os riscos das queimadas urbanas e rurais na Amazônia. A iniciativa mostra como atitudes do dia a dia podem ajudar a evitar incêndios e contribuir para a preservação do meio ambiente.

O lançamento acontece em um período de atenção para as condições climáticas da região. Segundo o Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (INPE), o fenômeno El Niño está presente em 2026 e pode contribuir para um período mais seco e quente na Amazônia. O boletim mais recente do órgão aponta 95% de probabilidade de o fenômeno atingir intensidade muito forte entre outubro e dezembro.

Com menos chuva e a vegetação mais seca, o fogo encontra condições mais favoráveis para se espalhar. Por isso, a campanha reforça que uma pequena chama pode virar um grande incêndio, principalmente quando o fogo é usado para limpar terrenos ou para queimar folhas e lixo próximo a áreas de vegetação.

O cenário também exige atenção no Amazonas. Dados históricos do Projeto Queimadas, do INPE, mostram que 35,3% dos picos de queimadas registrados no estado entre 2010 e 2026 ocorreram no mês de setembro. O dado reforça a importância de manter os cuidados mesmo após os meses tradicionalmente considerados mais críticos para as queimadas.

A campanha orienta a população a não usar fogo para limpar terrenos, não queimar folhas ou lixo em áreas de vegetação, fazer o descarte correto dos resíduos e evitar o acúmulo de materiais secos. A proposta é mostrar que cuidados simples podem ajudar a reduzir as chances de incêndios e seus impactos sobre o meio ambiente e as comunidades.

Para Anderson Mendes, gerente de Conteúdo da Fundação Rede Amazônica, a campanha busca aproximar o tema da realidade das pessoas.

“A gente quis trazer esse assunto para perto das pessoas, mostrando que uma atitude que parece simples, como colocar fogo em um terreno ou queimar lixo, pode ter consequências muito maiores. A prevenção começa justamente nessas escolhas do dia a dia, e a campanha busca reforçar essa consciência de forma simples e direta.”

A mensagem “Não deixe o verde dar lugar às cinzas” resume a proposta da campanha e reforça que a prevenção começa com pequenas atitudes. A iniciativa busca incentivar escolhas mais seguras e lembrar que evitar o uso do fogo também é uma forma de cuidar da Amazônia.

A campanha conta com o apoio da Tree Earth, que se soma à iniciativa na mobilização pela conscientização ambiental e pela preservação da floresta.

A Fundação Rede Amazônica é o braço institucional do Grupo Rede Amazônica e atua há mais de 40 anos nos estados de Rondônia, Roraima, Acre, Amapá e Amazonas, desenvolvendo iniciativas voltadas ao fortalecimento social, educacional, cultural e ambiental da região. A instituição organiza sua atuação em três pilares: Arte, Cultura e Educação; Inovação e Empreendedorismo; e Desenvolvimento Social e Sustentabilidade.

articles.title: Mega-Sena 3065: teve vencedor em Santa Catarina? | G1
articles.standfirst: Outras 112 apostas feitas em SC acertaram 4 números. Ninguém cravou as seis dezenas.
articles.summary: Outras 112 apostas feitas em SC acertaram 4 números.
articles.body:
Uma aposta simples de Chapecó , maior cidade do Oeste de Santa Catarina , acertou cinco números no concurso 3065 da Mega-Sena e levou R$ 49.503,22 . Ninguém cravou as seis dezenas e o prêmio acumulou em R$ 82 milhões .

Veja os números sorteados: 08 - 10 - 30 - 38 - 50 - 53

A aposta de Chapecó foi a única de Santa Catarina a acertar cinco números. Outras 112 acertaram quatro números e foram feitas no estado.

Em Chapecó, a aposta, com seis números, foi feita por meios eletrônicos.

Os que acertaram quatro números, levaram R$ 1.053,03.

A probabilidade de vencer em cada concurso varia de acordo com o número de dezenas jogadas e o tipo de aposta realizada. Para um jogo simples, com apenas seis dezenas, que custa R$ 6, a probabilidade de ganhar o prêmio milionário é de 1 em 50.063.860, segundo a Caixa.

Já para uma aposta com 20 dezenas (limite máximo), com o preço de R$ 232.560,00, a probabilidade de acertar o prêmio é de 1 em 1.292, ainda de acordo com a instituição.

articles.title: Why Bengaluru residents are pushing back against Airbnb-style stays in residential neighbourhoods
articles.summary: BENGALURU: Residents of HRBR Layout are pushing back against the proposed opening of a homestay-cum-café in their residential neighbourhood, raising
articles.body: BENGALURU: Residents of HRBR Layout are pushing back against the proposed opening of a homestay-cum-café in their residential neighbourhood, raising concerns over noise, pollution, parking and the impact of increased commercial activity on the area.Residents of 5th A Main Road, including young and elderly residents, took to the streets with banners and slogans to oppose Blossomly House, a proposed commercial homestay-cum-cafeteria.They argued that homestay-cum-café and similar commercial facilities should not be introduced in what they described as a peaceful residential layout.The residents have also raised concerns over an alleged encroachment of a rajakaluve beside the property and the proposed installation of a commercial exhaust system.They fear the exhaust could result in considerable noise, smoke, odour and air pollution for people living in the surrounding area.Why residents are opposing the homestayResidents said the proposed homestay-cum-café could bring a steady flow of visitors into the neighbourhood, increasing noise and disturbance in an area primarily meant for residential use.“If 20–30 or more people gather and smoke at the premises, it could create significant health and nuisance concerns for neighbouring residents. Along with that, with a large number of customers entering and leaving, talking, gathering and moving around, there is a possibility of increased noise disturbance in what is otherwise a residential area,” said resident KR Prabhakar.Parking is another concern for residents, particularly those who have lived in the neighbourhood for several years. They said neighbouring roads were already experiencing commercial activity and parking pressure, and feared that the proposed establishment could further reduce parking spaces available to locals.Gomathy Venkatesan, an elderly resident, alleged that the café management did not take her objections into consideration when she initially raised them.“I have been staying here for 35 years, but when we told the owner our disagreements, he asked us to bear all the issues and stay or vacate, adding that the road will soon become a commercial hub,” she told TOI.A former leader of opposition of the erstwhile Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP), who joined the protest, said the area was purely residential and that no commercial development would be allowed under any circumstances.Residents seek clarity on permissionsThe residents have also questioned whether the proposed establishment has all the permissions required to operate in the area. They have written to Bengaluru North City Corporation (BNCC), seeking verification of permissions related to zoning, land-use compliance and rajakaluve clearance.Their concerns come as the proposed property combines a homestay with a café, bringing together accommodation and a customer-facing commercial activity within the residential layout.I wanted to do this for the Gen-Z: Property owner Sachin Jain, who owns the upcoming property, said the café was intended to “give back something to the society”. He rejected the suggestion that the project was “very commercial” and said the aim was not to cause inconvenience to residents.“I wanted to do this for the Gen-Z; this is nothing like a traditional cafe and this place will strictly be a no-smoking zone. I am also planning to incorporate a library within the place along with a homestay so that youngsters can read and take in the ambience,” Sachin said.While residents have raised concerns about the nature and impact of Airbnb-style stays and commercial activity in their neighbourhood, the property owner has maintained that the proposed facility is intended to offer a different kind of space and would not be aimed at causing inconvenience to those living nearby.You Can Also Check: Gold Rate in Bengaluru | Silver Rate in Bengaluru | Bank Holidays in Bengaluru | Public Holidays in Bengaluru | Bengaluru AQI | Weather in Bengaluru | Petrol Price in Bengaluru | Diesel Price in Bengaluru | CNG Price in Bengaluru | LPG Price in BengaluruStay updated with the latest Bengaluru news. articles.title: ‘Mohammad’ Deepak arrested for ‘assaulting’ trader for Facebook comment on Ujjain mosque demolition
articles.summary: Dehradun’s Deepak Kumar aka “Mohd” Deepak arrested for allegedly assaulting and threatening a Kotdwar trader over a Facebook comment on Ujjain mosque demolition.
articles.body: DEHRADUN: Deepak Kumar aka ‘Mohammad’ Deepak, who shot into limelight for confronting members of Bajrang Dal who were harassing an elderly Muslim shopkeeper in Kotdwar area of Garhwal early this year, was arrested on Thursday evening for allegedly assaulting a local trader over an online comment related to ‘partial’ demolition of a mosque in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh.According to police, Sanjeev Tonk, the trader, accused Kumar, who used to run a gym, of assault over a comment made by him on a social media post purportedly uploaded by the latter.Pauri Garhwal SSP, Sarvesh Panwar, told TOI: “An FIR was registered against Kumar under BNS sections 115 (voluntarily causing hurt) and 351 (criminal intimidation). The complainant said ‘Kumar didn’t like one of his comments on Facebook’. So, he went to his shop and assaulted and threatened him on Thursday.”SSP added that since the punishment was less than seven years under the two BNS sections -- which prohibited arrests under legal provisions -- he was subsequently held under BNSS section 170 (arrest to prevent commission of cognisable offences).“Action was taken only after police sensed a law and order situation in the area. Kumar would be presented before the SDM under applicable laws on Friday,” he further said.In the two-minute-long video posted on his Facebook page on Sept 28, Kumar could be purportedly heard saying that “Muslims in Ujjain should protest peacefully and find an amicable solution to the matter”. The post went on to garner more than 19,000 likes and about 750 comments. One of the adverse comments was purportedly from Tonk.A Kotdwar resident, who claimed to have witnessed the incident, said the matter escalated Wednesday afternoon, when Kumar reached Tonk’s shop. “They had a heated argument,” he added.Stay updated with the latest Dehradun news. articles.standfirst: Carro-forte atingiu traseira de carreta em Santa Rita do Passa Quatro (SP) na noite de quinta-feira (1º). Colisão aconteceu na Rodovia Anhanguera, na pista sentido capital.
articles.summary: Carro-forte atingiu traseira de carreta em Santa Rita do Passa Quatro (SP) na noite de quinta-feira (1º). Colisão aconteceu na Rodovia Anhanguera, na pista sentido capital.
articles.body:
Duas pessoas morreram e outras duas ficaram gravemente feridas em um acidente entre um carro-forte e uma carreta, em Santa Rita do Passa Quatro (SP), na noite de quinta-feira (1º). As identidades das vítimas não foram divulgadas.

Segundo a concessionária ViaPaulista, o acidente aconteceu por volta das 22h, na Rodovia Anhanguera (SP-330), na pista sentido capital.

Duas pessoas morrem e duas ficam feridas em grave acidente em Santa Rita do Passa Quatro (SP) — Foto: Portal CCM – Artesp (ccm.artesp.sp.gov.br)

O carro-forte atingiu a traseira da carreta e, com o impacto, um dos ocupantes foi ejetado e morreu no local. Outra pessoa também não resistiu.

Os outros dois ocupantes do carro-forte ficaram gravemente feridos e foram levados para a Santa Casa de Porto Ferreira (SP). O motorista da carreta não se feriu.

O acidente provocou cerca de dois quilômetros de congestionamento. O acostamento e a faixa 2 ficaram interditados por quase sete horas, mas foram liberados ainda durante a madrugada desta sexta-feira (2).

articles.summary: Animal foi encontrado pelo próprio tutor dentro de um poço desativado na comunidade Catinga, na zona rural do município.
articles.body:
Um gato que estava desaparecido havia 15 dias foi resgatado de dentro de um poço desativado de aproximadamente 15 metros de profundidade , na comunidade Catinga, zona rural de Pedro II , no Norte do Piauí. O resgate aconteceu por volta das 12h30 de quinta-feira (1º).

Segundo o Grupamento de Bombeiros Civis e Brigadistas de Pedro II, o próprio tutor encontrou o animal dentro do poço e acionou a equipe. Os brigadistas se deslocaram até o local para realizar o resgate.

Vídeos mostram a ação dos bombeiros durante o resgate, descendo até o fundo do poço para resgatar o animal, que estava visivelmente debilitado.

A equipe conseguiu retirar o gato do poço com segurança. Segundo os bombeiros civis, o resgate foi concluído com êxito.

articles.title: In 2010, just 66 Christmas Island blue-tailed skinks were saved; 15 years later, 545 were released on a new island
articles.summary: In 2010, the Christmas Island blue-tailed skink was close to disappearing from the wild.
articles.body: In 2010, the Christmas Island blue-tailed skink was close to disappearing from the wild. Introduced predators had swept across Christmas Island, and a rapid rescue effort by Parks Australia staff saved just 66 individuals before the remaining wild population vanished. Those reptiles became the foundation of a captive breeding and conservation programme that continued for more than 15 years. In July 2026, the programme reached another milestone when 545 Christmas Island blue-tailed skinks were released into the wild on Horsburgh Island in the Cocos (Keeling) archipelago. The release marks the establishment of the species' third wild colony in the island group, offering it a larger habitat in which to build a population.Just 66 skinks were saved as predators swept across Christmas IslandThe Christmas Island blue-tailed skink is a small insect-eating lizard measuring around 10 to 12 centimetres long. It has a dark, striped body and a distinctive bright blue tail. The species is now listed as Extinct in the Wild on the IUCN Red List and is no longer found in its natural habitat on Christmas Island, according to Parks Australia.In 2010, introduced predators were rapidly affecting the species on its home island. Parks Australia staff at Christmas Island National Park mounted a rescue effort and captured 66 blue-tailed skinks before the remaining wild population disappeared. Those 66 animals became the founder population for a captive breeding and conservation programme.The effort was not limited to keeping the reptiles in captivity. Over more than 15 years, conservationists worked to produce animals that could eventually establish new wild populations away from the threats that had caused the original decline.Captive breeding helped establish skink colonies in the Cocos IslandsThe first major step towards returning the species to the wild came in 2019, when blue-tailed skinks were released on Pulu Blan, a tiny island in the Cocos (Keeling) group. Parks Australia later established another colony on neighbouring Pulu Blan Madar in 2020.The earlier releases were part of an effort to establish populations away from Christmas Island, where the skinks had disappeared from the wild. The population on Pulu Blan was increasing through natural recruitment after its release. The Pulu Blan Madar population faced difficulties after invasive yellow crazy ants were discovered, prompting park staff to undertake control measures.By 2026, the conservation programme had produced enough skinks for a much larger release. Parks Australia says 545 animals were taken to Horsburgh Island, making it the third island in the Cocos group to receive a population of Christmas Island blue-tailed skinks. The new colony therefore represents another attempt to establish the species in the wild after it disappeared from Christmas Island.Horsburgh Island gives the rare skinks a much larger new homeHorsburgh Island offers a substantially larger area than the two earlier release sites. According to Parks Australia, it is about 50 times the size of either Pulu Blan or Pulu Blan Madar, giving the skinks the potential to establish a larger and more resilient population.Getting the animals there was itself a complex logistical operation. Blue-tailed skinks from four separate populations were transported to Horsburgh, with the journey involving both aircraft and boats. Some of the animals travelled from as far away as Sydney before reaching their new tropical home.The release was led by Parks Australia and Taronga Conservation Society Australia, with support from the Shire of Cocos (Keeling) Islands, the local Cocos community and Qantas. The 545 reptiles now form the third wild colony of this Christmas Island native in the Cocos (Keeling) archipelago.The story of the blue-tailed skink has therefore moved from a rescue of 66 animals in 2010 to the release of 545 into a new island habitat in 2026. For a species that no longer survives in the wild on its original home, the Horsburgh Island population is another step in an ongoing effort to rebuild wild colonies.You use AI every day. articles.title: A 2-km stretch of British coast was once a golf course; its fairways are now wetlands where birds are nesting
articles.summary: A stretch of Lincolnshire coastline that was once occupied by a golf course has been transformed into a new nature reserve, with wetlands, grassland and
articles.body: A stretch of Lincolnshire coastline that was once occupied by a golf course has been transformed into a new nature reserve, with wetlands, grassland and coastal scrub now replacing much of its manicured landscape. Sandilands, near Sutton-on-Sea and Mablethorpe, was acquired by the National Trust in March 2020 after the golf club went into liquidation in 2018. Six years of planning, consultation and habitat creation later, the site has officially opened as a 30-hectare coastal nature reserve. The restored landscape now provides a mixture of shallow pools, wading areas and newly established habitats designed to support both resident wildlife and migratory birds along the Lincolnshire coast. The transformation has also opened the former private golf landscape to the wider public, with new paths and accessible facilities allowing visitors to experience the changing coastal habitat.From golf fairways to coastal wetlandsThe National Trust says the reserve covers 30 hectares, equivalent to around 42 football pitches, and forms part of the wider Lincolnshire Coastal Country Park. It occupies a 2-km stretch of coastline and now contains a mosaic of wetlands, reedbeds, wildflower-rich grassland and coastal habitats. The Trust says the restored landscape is intended to provide habitat for breeding birds as well as a stopover for migratory species travelling along Britain's east coast.The site has a much longer history with golf than its 2018 closure might suggest. The National Trust says the land had been used as a golf course since 1894, although Sandilands Golf Club itself was formed in 1952. The club entered liquidation in 2018 after financial difficulties, bringing an end to its use as a private golf course. The National Trust acquired the coastal land in March 2020 with support from a donor and its Neptune Coastline Campaign. It was the organisation's first coastal land acquisition in Lincolnshire. The restoration was then carried out as a six-year programme of planning, consultation and habitat creation.Birds arrived before the project was finishedOne of the most striking signs of the transformation has been the speed at which birds have begun using the newly created habitats. According to the National Trust, avocets and oystercatchers successfully nested and bred at Sandilands in 2026, while little ringed plover chicks were recorded at the site for the second consecutive year. The Guardian reported that little ringed plovers and avocets nested during the summer after former fairways and bunkers were reshaped into shallow pools and islands suitable for shore and marsh birds. Marsh harriers have also been seen hunting over the reserve, while water rails, sandwich terns and spotted redshanks have been recorded at the site. The reserve is also expected to provide habitat for lapwings, snipe, terns and gulls, as well as migratory species including black-tailed godwits, spotted redshanks and spoonbills. The National Trust describes the area as part of the internationally important East Coast Flyway, through which thousands of birds travel between breeding grounds in the Arctic and northern Europe and wintering areas farther south.A landscape deliberately reshaped for wildlifeCreating the wetlands required major earthworks. Nearly 52,000 cubic metres of earth were moved to create the new habitats, a volume the National Trust compares with 21 Olympic swimming pools. Green hay from a nearby Lincolnshire Wildlife Trust reserve was also spread across the site to help establish species-rich grassland containing plants such as wild carrot, yarrow, yellow rattle and red clover.The restoration has also involved extensive planting of native coastal vegetation. The National Trust's September 2026 press release says more than 35,000 native coastal shrubs, including sea buckthorn, gorse, goat willow and blackthorn, have been planted. However, the Trust's current project page separately reports more than 6,500 native scrub plants planted with the help of more than 200 volunteers. Because the two current National Trust sources give different totals, the planting figure is best treated cautiously rather than presenting the two numbers as interchangeable. The project has also changed the way the land is managed. The Guardian reported that areas of grass have been left unmown, allowing additional plant species to emerge, while volunteers have been helping control plants such as ragwort and thistles during the early stages of the habitat's development.A new public space on the Lincolnshire coastSandilands was once accessible primarily to golf-club members. It is now open to the wider public, with new paths, boardwalks and accessible facilities running through the reserve. A visitor welcome building includes a café and community space. The project has also involved local residents and volunteers. The Guardian reported that around 50 people were already volunteering at the reserve when it visited in September, while the National Trust says more than 200 volunteers have helped with scrub planting.The restoration is part of the much larger Lincolnshire Coastal Country Park, which the National Trust says covers around 3,500 hectares and includes a five-mile stretch of coastline. Sandilands adds another area of wetlands and coastal habitat to that wider network. There are further plans for the reserve as its habitats develop. The National Trust says Highland ponies will be introduced for conservation grazing, while the Guardian reported that the Trust hopes to reintroduce natterjack toads once the pond habitats are suitable. The transformation does not mean the landscape is considered finished. articles.body: Ukraine has claimed the first combat use of its domestically developed FP-7 tactical ballistic missile, marking a new step in Kyiv’s push to build an indigenous long-range strike capability. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced the missile’s battlefield debut on October 1.According to The War Zone (TWZ), Zelenskyy did not disclose where the FP-7 was used, what target it struck, how many missiles were launched or what damage they caused. The report also noted that the claim of its first combat use has not been independently verified.Zelenskyy, in a post on Telegram, said the “Ukrainian tactical ballistic missile, FP-7” had seen its “first combat use”, adding, “Thank you for the result. Next up: production.”He also shared a video purportedly showing the missile being launched at night, but did not disclose the target or location of the strike.The FP-7 is a ground-launched tactical ballistic missile developed by Ukrainian defence company Fire Point.According to TWZ, it has a reported range of around 250 km, a warhead of about 150 kg, and a reported speed of around 1,500 metres per second.It is designed for shorter-range strikes against targets such as logistics hubs, air-defence sites and drone bases, rather than deep strikes far behind the frontline.The FP-7 is part of Ukraine’s broader effort to develop indigenous ballistic missiles and reduce reliance on Western-supplied strike systems.Its reported range places it in a tactical strike category, giving Kyiv another option for hitting targets within roughly 250 km of the launch point.Fire Point is also developing a larger FP-9 ballistic missile, with a reported range of up to 850 km, which company officials say could be ready by the end of 2026.

articles.title: 'He has good ideas': Putin lauds PM Modi's peace push to end Russia-Ukraine war
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday lauded Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s efforts to seek an end to the Ukraine conflict, saying that he has
articles.body: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday lauded Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s efforts to seek an end to the Ukraine conflict, saying that he has “good ideas” for achieving a peaceful resolution."Prime Minister Narendra Modi is one of those world leaders who, despite our very good and even friendly relations, personal good relations, constantly raises the question and asks the question about putting an end to the conflict in Ukraine," Putin said.Asked about the issue at the Valdai Club forum, Putin said Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been actively working to find mutually acceptable solutions to the Ukraine conflict."He has an avid interest and very good ideas aimed at finding mutually acceptable solutions. In that sense, naturally, the Prime Minister takes a neutral position but with an interest in the end of the conflict. I think it's my duty to say that directly. And we are thankful to the Prime Minister for his ideas," Putin said.Putin thanked PM Modi for his efforts and continued support for resolving the Ukraine conflict through dialogue."We are thankful for his desire to put an end to this conflict through peaceful means and as soon as possible," he added.Prime Minister Modi and Putin last met in September on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, where they discussed strengthening trade ties, including the implementation of the Programme for Economic Cooperation 2030, along with cooperation in infrastructure, energy, technology, defence and culture.PM Modi has repeatedly called for peace, stressing that India has maintained a principled and humanitarian approach to the Russia-Ukraine conflict."India has maintained a principled and humanitarian stance on the conflict which is equally appreciated by both President Putin and President Zelenskyy. In line with this, both the leaders spoke to me to share their perspectives on the developments related to the conflict. I reiterated India's principled and consistent stand and encouraged dialogue and diplomacy to resolve the conflict," the Prime Minister said during an interview with Japanese news outlet 'The Yomiuri Shimbun' while on a visit to the country in August.Responding to a question on India’s role in peace efforts between the two countries, Prime Minister Modi said, "I have already indicated India's willingness to support meaningful efforts aimed at achieving a peaceful resolution of the conflict. I believe, by virtue of our good relations with both sides, including key stakeholders, we can strengthen efforts dedicated to the restoration of an early and lasting peace in Ukraine."This comes as Putin reiterated Moscow’s long-standing position that Russia has no plans to attack European countries, while warning that it would respond to any aggression with “all weapons” at its disposal.He also accused Western countries, particularly in Europe, of escalating tensions by discussing preparations for a possible war with Moscow, conducting military drills in the Baltic Sea and seizing Russian vessels.European leaders and intelligence agencies have warned that Russia could be capable of launching an attack on another country within the next few years, particularly if it emerges victorious from the war in Ukraine.You use AI every day. articles.title: 'Haunted by last night': Witnesses describe Tennessee convict Christa Pike's failed execution
articles.summary: Witnesses to the failed execution of Christa Pike, who was scheduled to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in 20 years, described horrific
articles.body: Witnesses to the failed execution of Christa Pike, who was scheduled to become the first woman executed in Tennessee in 20 years, described horrific scenes after she was administered two lethal injections.Tori Gessner, a media witness to the execution, said the experience left her feeling “haunted.”“I’m haunted by last night. What I saw last night is not something that should ever, ever happen again,” Gessner told CNN.She later provided a detailed account of the events leading up to and following Pike’s failed execution.The witnesses were escorted into the witness chamber at 6:41 pm. local time on Wednesday. At 7:26 pm, the blinds providing a view into the execution chamber were opened, and Pike delivered her final statement.Also Read | Christa Pike, who survived two lethal injections in a ‘miracle’ that changed her lifeAt 7:34 pm, Pike reported that her arm felt like it was “about to burst.” Over the next several minutes, she appeared to be talking, breathing, moaning and snoring.Catherine Sweeney, another media witness, described the scene as "completely abnormal."“None of it was normal. I covered all the executions last year, and most of the ones this year. We haven’t seen anything like it. It went really poorly," she added.Meanwhile, Pike’s legal team released a statement on Thursday, saying the execution team spent an hour attempting to establish an IV line and used at least seven needles in her left arm.“She did not have a fear of dying. It was a fear of prolonged, painful, traumatic death. That’s what happened, minus the death,” the statement read.Bill Lee, Tennessee’s Republican governor, subsequently announced that he would call off the state’s last remaining execution this year pending a third-party review to “determine what exactly occurred” during Pike’s execution attempt. Pike remains in critical condition and is receiving life-saving medical care.Pike, 50, was sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer. articles.title: Cornell sexual assault case: Snapchat records, police transcript prompt fresh probe
articles.summary: Snapchat messages exchanged during a sexual assault at Cornell University in 2024 included a photograph of then-student Jane Doe inside the Chi Phi
articles.body: Snapchat messages exchanged during a sexual assault at Cornell University in 2024 included a photograph of then-student Jane Doe inside the Chi Phi fraternity house, according to images of the messages obtained by CNN.The messages, shared in a group chat titled “Chi Phi Actives”, have raised questions about whether additional photographs or videos from the night could have been recovered through a more extensive criminal investigation, according to a source close to the case.The revelations come as new details emerge about the alleged gang rape of Doe at the fraternity house, including what she told campus police weeks after the incident.New York State Attorney General Letitia James will now take over the case as special prosecutor, New York Governor Kathy Hochul announced Thursday, saying she had “lost faith” in the Tompkins County district attorney’s ability to oversee it.“New information has raised serious questions about how this case was handled, and I’ve lost faith in the Tompkins County DA’s ability to fairly oversee it,” Hochul said in a statement. “The young woman at the center of this case deserves to know that every fact will be examined and justice pursued.”James will have the authority to investigate the incident and, if warranted, prosecute any offenses and present evidence to a grand jury. Cornell University said Thursday that it supports the governor’s decision.What the Snapchat messages showThe Snapchat messages were exchanged during the alleged assault in a group chat titled “Chi Phi Actives”, according to images of the conversation obtained by CNN. The messages included a photograph of Doe inside a room at the fraternity house.Because Snapchat messages can disappear quickly, a source close to the case told CNN that a more thorough criminal investigation might have recovered additional photographs or videos.New details from Title IX recordsThe latest disclosures also include hundreds of pages of emails, text messages, photographs and interviews from Cornell’s formal Title IX investigation. The records, obtained by The New York Times and corroborated by Doe’s attorney, include interviews with Doe, her friends and six of the seven men she accused, as well as a transcript of her original police interviews, according to the Times.The records shed new light on how Doe initially understood the night’s events, how she discussed them with her roommates and how she communicated with some of the men before reporting the allegations to university police.“Ms. Doe’s internal processing went from denial, to shame and ultimately acceptance that she had been raped by people that she thought were her friends,” her attorney, Thomas P. Giuffra, told CNN Thursday. “Her reactions were a textbook reaction to trauma.”According to the Times’ review of the Title IX files, Doe returned home after the alleged assault on October 19, 2024, and told her two roommates that she had consumed ketamine and had sex with multiple men. One roommate said Doe did not use the words “rape” or “assault” at that point.Another roommate said she could not remember Doe saying yes to anything that occurred, while a second roommate said Doe appeared to be “in shock” and was “not really understanding the gravity of what she was saying.”The following day, Doe reportedly spoke with her sorority big sister, who later told investigators that “what she was going through is that she had not yet processed what had happened.”Doe also communicated with at least two of the men she later accused of sexual assault. In a message to one of them, she reportedly said “non of the sexual stuff was illegal.”Doe’s attorney said she later came to terms with what had happened and went to a health professional a few days after the incident.What Doe told campus policeDoe, who is identified as Jane Doe in a civil lawsuit, told Cornell University police during a two-day interview in November 2024 that she could say with “100% confidence” that she was raped, according to a transcript obtained by CBS News.The transcript records Doe saying she was “completely and totally incapacitated” and describing sexual encounters that she said became coercive after she had consumed alcohol and drugs.At one point, she said she had been physically hit and had pushed away unwanted touching. She also told investigators that she had said she was uncomfortable, that she was tired and, on some occasions, no.When investigators asked whether she eventually gave in after becoming exhausted from dealing with the men, she responded: “Yes. It was coercion.”When asked about the later part of the night, she said: “I can say with 100% confidence I was raped.”She also said she did not remember the end of the night and did not know how many people had sex with her while she was in that state.Questions over the initial investigationTompkins County District Attorney Matthew Van Houten has repeatedly told CNN that his office received no more than the Snapchat messages and a six-page investigative report before deciding not to bring charges.The report said Doe recounted being hit and feeling emotionally coerced into sexual activity while intoxicated.Doe made a more explicit accusation of rape during a November 2024 interview with campus police. Van Houten told CNN that his office never received the transcript of that interview.The governor’s decision to appoint James as special prosecutor comes as questions remain about the initial investigation and what information was available to the county district attorney’s office when it decided not to pursue charges.You use AI every day. articles.body: India's indigenous Akash air defence missile system has expanded its footprint into Central Asia, with Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh confirming that the system has been exported to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan, in addition to Armenia.Speaking to ANI, Rajesh Kumar Singh said Armenia was the first foreign customer for Akash and had acquired multiple batteries. “The first customer was Armenia, which has taken multiple batteries. Thereafter, we've also exported it to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan,” he said.He described Akash as one of India's defence export success stories, pointing to the system's indigenous development and the growing maturity of the country's missile production capabilities.He further said Akash has emerged as an effective system for dealing with high velocity aerial targets, while production of the missile system has now stabilised. He said the Indian armed forces have placed additional orders for the system and indicated that further international demand could emerge from other countries.The exports mark a wider international push for India's indigenous air defence capabilities, with Armenia becoming the first overseas customer for Akash before the system expanded into Central Asia. The export of Akash to Tajikistan and Turkmenistan gives India a growing defence presence in the region.About Akash air defence systemThe Akash is an indigenous short range surface to air missile system developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) to protect vulnerable areas and vulnerable points from aerial attacks.DRDO says the weapon system can simultaneously engage multiple targets in either group or autonomous mode and incorporates electronic counter countermeasures (ECCM). The system is configured on mobile platforms and is operational with both the Indian Air Force and Indian Army.According to the ministry of defence, the system has an operational range of 4.5 km to 25 km and can engage aerial targets at altitudes between 100 metres and 20 km. articles.title: In 1971, retired teacher Margaret Minshall donated over 400 acres to San Diego County; the land is now Oakoasis Open Space Preserve
articles.summary: Land transfers often outlast the people who make them, and Margaret Minshall's are a good example.
articles.body: Land transfers often outlast the people who make them, and Margaret Minshall's are a good example. She was a retired high school teacher and avid equestrian. In 1971, she gave more than 400 acres of her Oakasis Ranch, near the San Vicente Reservoir, to the County of San Diego. Four years later, in 1975, she transferred another 41.67-acre parcel to California State Parks, strengthening the northeastern edge of Cuyamaca Rancho State Park. Her name lives on in a hiking trail, and her ranch house, destroyed in the 2003 Cedar Wildfire, stood in what is now the Oakoasis Open Space Preserve.Margaret Minshall: Retired high school teacher behind two public land transfersThe state's historic background study ‘Cuyamaca Rancho State Park, Historic Background Study & Historic Inventory’ describes Margaret Minshall as a retired high school teacher and avid equestrian who was known as "Mardy" or "Marti". By the mid-1970s, she lived in the former residence of Harvey Moore, the first custodian of Cuyamaca Rancho State Park, near the old Stonewall Mine area. She was engrossed in tireless volunteering, particularly in founding the park's interpretation association. Her story appears briefly in a document by Alexander Bevil, a historian with California's Department of Parks and Recreation, who wrote the study in February 2014 as an overview of the park's historic events, locations and individuals.Minshall’s 1971 transfer of more than 400 acres of Oakasis RanchIn 1971, Minshall donated more than 400 acres of her former Oakasis Ranch, near the San Vicente Reservoir, to the County of San Diego. The study describes this as the same arrangement she later made with the state. According to its bibliography, the San Diego Union reported the transfer on 28 August 1971, describing a 400-acre park given to the county. Decades later, the 2003 Cedar Wildfire destroyed her ranch house in what is now the Oakoasis Open Space Preserve.The 1975 transfer of 41.67 acres to California State ParksOn 22 April 1975, California State Parks acquired 41.67 acres from Minshall next to the old Stonewall Mine area. As part of the transfer, she kept the right to reach her home, the former Harvey Moore residence, and her barn over an existing road for the rest of her life. The acquisition helped consolidate the park's northeastern boundary, creating a buffer around the lower Stonewall Mine area and better connectivity there. The mine itself was one of the richest in Southern California, eventually producing about $1 million in gold bullion. A collapsed pit, stone foundation ruins, tailings piles and scattered machinery still mark its site.The Minshall Trail at Lake Cuyamaca and the lasting legacy of Margaret MinshallCalifornia State Parks honoured Minshall by dedicating the Minshall Trail in her name, in appreciation of her generosity and tireless volunteering. The former Lake Loop Trail passes the site of her residence, runs around the southwest shore of Lake Cuyamaca and links the Stonewall and Kelly Ditch Trails. It is one of three trails named after people who played key roles in the park's development, alongside the Harvey Moore Trail and one for Vern Whitaker, an honorary State Parks ranger and exemplary volunteer. The study adds that wildfires remain the greatest threat to the park's historic resources, citing fires such as the October 2003 Cedar Wildfire, which burned over Japacha Ridge.You use AI every day. articles.title: Gyanesh Kumar: CJP, or Cockroach Janta Party, calls for protests against election chief
articles.summary: Thousands of people have turned up at a protest in Mumbai called by the Cockroach Janta Party.
articles.body:
India's influential Gen Z-led "cockroach" protesters are back on the streets - this time seeking electoral reforms and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of manipulating voter rolls.

A pressure group which began as an online satirical movement, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) recorded its first major victory in July when it forced education minister Dharmendra Pradhan to resign after weeks of protests calling for education reforms.

CEC Kumar or the Election Commission have not responded to the calls for his resignation from the CJP or opposition parties. They have also not responded to allegations of vote theft or elections being rigged. The BBC has asked them for comment.

On Friday, thousands of people joined a protest called by the CJP at the sprawling Shivaji Park grounds in Mumbai city "to save democracy" and seek CEC Kumar's resignation.

The CJP has said this is the first in a series of demonstrations it plans to hold across the country in October, culminating in a rally in the capital, Delhi.

Most people in the crowds were young supporters of the CJP - some told the BBC they had come from the far suburbs of Mumbai and even from outside the city, from places such as Nagpur.

There was a heavy police presence at the venue. A small stage was set up on a truck from where CJP leaders are speaking.

In Delhi, however, police detained hundreds of people who were trying to protest at Jantar Mantar, a central site in the capital where the last CJP protest took place.

The CJP called the protest after last week's report in The Indian Express that CEC Kumar's two fellow election commissioners, Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, had formally objected at least 14 times over 10 months to decisions and orders they said had been issued without their knowledge.

The differences were reported to be mostly over a controversial revision of the country's electoral rolls known as the Special Intensive Revision, or SIR, which began last year.

The Election Commission says the exercise is intended to remove duplicate and ineligible entries - and so far, 130 million names have been struck off the voters' list.

But opposition parties and activists have alleged that many of those are eligible voters and that the process is being manipulated by CEC Kumar to favour Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) during elections. Both the BJP and the Election Commission have rejected the accusations.

Last week's Indian Express report said the two commissioners had also been raising questions over the integrity of the voter database, changes to the way new voters are enrolled and the security of the electoral rolls itself.

The EC defended its way of working and said in a statement that "differing views" were part of the "decision-making process" and that all the decisions were taken unanimously.

But the revelations sparked a furore, with opposition leaders demanding Kumar's resignation.

Leader of the opposition and senior Congress party leader Rahul Gandhi has repeatedly accused the commission of "stealing votes from the opposition" and said those officers who were indulging in "vote theft" were "traitors".

Another senior opposition leader, Mamata Banerjee, has demanded the CEC's arrest.

On Wednesday, the INDIA alliance - an opposition grouping that includes nearly two dozen parties and has both Gandhi and Banerjee as members - said they would also organise protest rallies across the country in the coming days. On 6 October, all opposition MPs plan to march to the Election Commission office in Delhi, they added.

articles.title: More than 1 million bats emerge from CNN founder Ted Turner's New Mexico ranch; ancient lava tubes shelter one of North America's largest bat populations
articles.summary: Every summer evening, more than 1 million Mexican free-tailed bats can emerge from ancient lava tubes on a New Mexico ranch, streaming into the desert sky
articles.body: Every summer evening, more than 1 million Mexican free-tailed bats can emerge from ancient lava tubes on a New Mexico ranch, streaming into the desert sky as they begin their nightly search for insects. The spectacle takes place at Armendaris Ranch, a 362,885-acre property in south-central New Mexico along the Rio Grande that was owned by the late Ted Turner. Turner Enterprises describes the Jornada lava field's tubes as the summer home of one of the largest bat populations in North America, while the current Ted Turner Reserves experience says over 1 million bats can rush from the caves at sunset. The Nature Conservancy, which has worked for decades to protect the site, provides a more specific breakdown, describing a maternal colony of well over 100,000 Mexican free-tailed bats and noting that millions of migratory bats use the caves as a warm-season stopover.Armendaris Ranch and the Jornada Bat Caves: a major bat site in New MexicoThe Jornada Bat Caves are a network of long lava tubes formed by the Jornada lava flow. The caves intersect one another and extend for hundreds of feet, creating underground roosting spaces for bats on the northern end of Armendaris Ranch. The Nature Conservancy says Mexican free-tailed bats occupy the caves from March through October, with a protected maternal colony numbering well over 100,000. It also says only about five cave complexes in the United States host larger populations of Mexican free-tailed bats, with Texas's Eckert James River Bat Cave being the largest.Mexican free-tailed bats are not the only species recorded at the site. The Nature Conservancy says seven other bat species have been identified at the Jornada caves, bringing the total to eight species. These include Allen's big-eared bat and the spotted bat. The site therefore supports both a large seasonal population of Mexican free-tailed bats and a broader assemblage of bat species using the lava tubes. The numbers associated with the caves can vary depending on what is being counted. The Nature Conservancy refers to the resident maternal colony as numbering well over 100,000 and separately says millions of migratory bats use the caves as a stopover during the warm season. Turner Enterprises and its tourism operation, meanwhile, promote the evening emergence as a spectacle in which more than 1 million Mexican free-tailed bats leave the caves. These figures should not be treated as competing estimates of a single permanent colony.From guano mining to bat conservationThe caves were not always managed primarily as a wildlife habitat. According to the Nature Conservancy, bat guano was mined there from the late 19th century and continued to be removed well into the 1980s for use as fertiliser. Miners blasted openings into the ceilings of the lava tubes to make it easier to extract the guano. The resulting shafts allowed light into parts of the caves, reducing the amount of suitable roosting habitat available to bats.The Nature Conservancy began working to protect the site decades ago. In the late 1980s, it approached Tenneco, the Houston-based company that held mineral rights in the area, about protecting the caves. In 1993, Tenneco donated mineral rights associated with 5,175 acres, including the Jornada Bat Caves, to the conservation organisation. Ted Turner subsequently acquired the property as part of his purchase of the Armendaris Ranch. The Nature Conservancy says Turner worked with the organisation and the University of New Mexico on efforts to restore the caves for bats. Ranch staff have since taken steps to restrict access and protect the site from disturbance, while conservation work has included repairing the openings created by earlier mining activity.Watching the Mexican free-tailed bats emerge at duskThe bat emergence has also become one of the wildlife experiences associated with Armendaris. Ted Turner Reserves currently offers an Armendaris Bat Flight Expedition, which operates during the summer and allows guests to watch the bats emerge from the caves at sunset. The company says the experience runs from June through August and describes more than 1 million Mexican free-tailed bats taking flight along the Rio Grande.The experience is part of a broader conservation-focused tourism operation connected with Turner's New Mexico properties. Ted Turner Reserves describes its hospitality business as being built around conservation and says guest stays help generate revenue for conservation projects. At Armendaris itself, the property supports a range of wildlife beyond the bats, including bison, pronghorn, desert mule deer, mountain lions, javelina and oryx. The ranch is also involved in conservation programmes for species including desert bighorn sheep and the Bolson tortoise. Turner Enterprises says the Fra Cristobal Mountains on Armendaris are home to a successfully reintroduced desert bighorn sheep population, while the Turner Endangered Species Fund is involved in Bolson tortoise recovery work.A living part of Ted Turner's conservation legacyTurner died on May 6, 2026, at the age of 87, his family announced through Turner Enterprises. The company credited him with decades of conservation work, including efforts involving endangered and imperilled species and the preservation of more than two million acres of land. The Jornada Bat Caves remain under protection on the private Armendaris Ranch, and the Nature Conservancy currently lists the caves as closed to the general public outside authorised access. For visitors taking part in the organised bat experience, however, the summer emergence offers a rare view of the scale of wildlife supported by the desert landscape. As dusk settles over the ranch, the bats pour from the lava tubes and disappear across the Rio Grande valley, continuing a seasonal cycle that has made the Jornada caves one of New Mexico's most notable bat sites.You use AI every day. articles.title: From Chettinad to Champaran: 5 egg curries from different parts of India
articles.summary: Protein is an essential part of a healthy diet, helping you stay full for longer and supporting overall health.
articles.body: Protein is an essential part of a healthy diet, helping you stay full for longer and supporting overall health. And when it comes to convenient, affordable sources of protein, eggs are hard to beat. They also provide important nutrients, including vitamin B12, vitamin D, selenium and choline, as per PubMed.But eggs don’t have to be limited to your breakfast plate. Across India, they are transformed into spicy curries, comforting gravies, aromatic masalas and even parcels cooked in banana leaves. From the fiery flavours of Chettinad to the homestyle dishes of Bihar, here are five regional egg recipes that can turn the humble egg into a satisfying lunch or dinner.Chettinad egg curry recipeChettinad cuisine is a symphony of flavors from Tamil Nadu. It’s famous for its fiery spices, roasted masalas and generous use of curry leaves and coconut. While Chettinad preparations are often associated with chicken and other meats, eggs can make an equally satisfying dish.For Chettinad egg curry, hard-boiled eggs are added to a rich, spicy gravy made with roasted spices, chillies and coconut, allowing them to soak up all those flavours. Serve it with chapati or rice for a hearty meal.Champaran-style egg curryBihar’s favourite Champaran-style curry also finds its way into eggs. Traditionally prepared in a clay pot coated with mustard oil, hard-boiled eggs are coated in a spice mix of garlic, green chillies, coriander powder, red chilli powder, cumin powder, turmeric and curd.Once marinated, the eggs are cooked in the clay pot itself for around half an hour on low heat. Serve it with rice or chapati for a comforting meal.Malvani egg curryMalvani cuisine from Maharashtra is known for hot cooking and spicy combinations. One such blend is a combination of roasted spices with nutmeg, coconut, dagadphool or stone flower and chilies. These bold flavours are complemented by the sweetness of onions and tomatoes.Hard-boiled eggs are then added to the gravy and allowed to soak up the flavours. Serve it with rice or bhakri for a hearty meal.Nargisi koftaWho doesn’t love a rich and royal kofta? From the Nawabi kitchens of Awadh, Nargisi kofta is a regal dish in which a hard-boiled egg is encased in layers of spicy keema and deep-fried. The kofta is then sliced open, revealing a pattern reminiscent of flower petals. In fact, the dish is named after the narcissus flower because of its appearance.The koftas are then cooked in an aromatic gravy made with ginger, garlic, turmeric, chillies, garam masala and onions. Serve this with saffron-infused ghee rice for a royal finishing touch.Dimer paturiWho knew eggs could be served in banana leaf parcels? Bengal’s love for paturi extends across meat, paneer, vegetables and eggs.For dimer paturi, the hard-boiled egg is marinated in a spicy mix of mustard, chilli, oil and coconut, and then steamed in a banana leaf parcel. Serve it hot with steamed rice and green chillies.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ testGet the latest Lifestyle News and more. Download the TOI app.
